title: Attention mechanisms
text: Transformers use self-attention to weigh the relevance of every token to every other token in a sequence.

title: Low-rank adaptation
text: LoRA fine-tunes large language models by training small low-rank matrices while the original weights stay frozen.

title: Dense retrieval
text: Dense retrievers map queries and documents into a shared vector space and rank documents by embedding similarity.

title: BM25 ranking
text: BM25 is a sparse lexical ranking function based on term frequency, inverse document frequency and document length.

title: Gradient descent
text: Gradient descent minimizes a loss function by repeatedly stepping the parameters against the gradient.

title: Convolutional networks
text: Convolutional neural networks learn spatial filters and are widely used for image classification.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
text: RAG systems retrieve relevant passages and feed them to a language model so answers are grounded in sources.

title: Speech recognition
text: Modern speech recognition models transcribe audio into text using encoder-decoder transformers.
